_comment: Wild roster - 50 creatures converted from the design-lane drop (docs/design-lane/generated/creatures.json) by tools/drop-converter/convert.py. Biomes mapped to elements; gifts/rewards use the drop's resource ids (registered in resources_digital.json); demands are any-commons at the drop's qty; light_change values are carried by the engine's existing band flows, not duplicated here. Regenerate with the converter, do not hand-edit.
